performance.interpretation: Frame-time and FPS are reference-machine observations, not universal acceptance thresholds. 5-second frames and unbounded retained growth are structural failures.

catalogGeneration.reason: Catalog generation inputs/policy/tools/approved source artifacts unchanged.

lengthAudit.shorterTextCaps: Removed both 120 caps; rename boundedTitleSchema also used by route and builder. World names have no shorter cap. Font metrics, shaping, glyph generation and layout have no shorter length cap; rendering dense names uses full-text fallback.

regionResolver.implementation: Full approved server Admin 1 index with canonical version/root-bound references; bounded ambiguity, region/operation/request cap checks, exact reference membership, authority validation and original source classification survive ownership changes.

labels.implementation: Approved exact seed glyphs + bounded server affected-country layout using existing font/layout/typography; stable promoted native feature IDs for actual contrast paint; incremental updateData; exact seed restoration on undo; zero layout for controller/color/camera.

commonE2E.implementation: Common actions use schema-asserting V3 fixture without legacy cookie. Historical source/geometry and comparative camera benchmark remain explicitly isolated.

nameLength.implementation: Both 120-character limits replaced by the existing common 160-character title schema; permanent real font/API and V3 atomic history tests. Seed outline role restoration also corrected.

remainingLimitations: Live paid GPT responses not exercised; deterministic provider fixtures are explicitly identified.
Changed-country geometry/layout work is server-side and cached (32 entries); expensive union/layout remains synchronous and is outside camera callbacks.
Camera frame-time/FPS figures are reference-machine observations; passing structural gates is not a 60 FPS guarantee.

Region references identify original source classification, while the full local state remains the definitive current owner/controller validator. A clipped authority scope cannot authorize omitted territories.
Unchanged high-cost catalog generation is retained from approval; its skipped test is not a new production pass.
Dense labels use a complete wrapped 14px fallback instead of unreadably compressed geographic glyphs.

environment.buildMode: Next production E2E build, single worker; isolated legacy fixture vs default V3

performance.interpretation: Frame-time and FPS are reference-machine observations, not universal acceptance thresholds. 5-second frames and unbounded retained growth are structural failures.

providerFixtureBoundary.region: Actual production route, Responses tool loop, approved server index, server validator, HTTP client receipt, local planner and atomic runtime. Only provider transport responses replaced through explicit E2E build alias.
providerFixtureBoundary.commonUi: Existing browser NDJSON fixtures replace the turn endpoint and bypass provider/server validation; UI/local planner/atomic runtime and label endpoint remain actual. These do not establish resolver/server coverage.
providerFixtureBoundary.productionColorSmoke: Ordinary production build, real UI and local atomic runtime; turn endpoint is a deterministic browser fixture. This alone is not server validation evidence.

productionWhiteCountry.result: Actual ordinary production screenshot shows dark Austria glyphs on white territories; native rendered feature IDs and contrast state also asserted by smoke.

visualInspection.result: Actual V3 screenshots show existing curved glyph geometry, white fill and contrasting outline. All four representative countries also asserted actual rendered fill/outline at two zooms.
